reviews.text:
Alba and the team took care of Gus today after a very stressful time of having to operate on my 16 year old dog.
Thank you as always for your amazing care and calm manner.
All team is always very welcoming, assuring and supportive in the best way they can. We always feel in save hands, thank you.
My experience at Medivet White Hart Lane has always been very good. It's a small vet but the vets, nurses and receptionists are always very pleasant and welcoming and efficient and very helpful.
Many thanks Alba & staff. Highly recommended as super knowledgeable, friendly and caring.
Great Vets, they truly care about animals and have taken great care of our two dogs over the years. I would highly recommend them

Our two cats have been well cared for over many years at White Hart Lane. When necessary they have been referred to the Chalkers Corner emergency centre, where our younger cat had a cut on her stomach sewn up.  In particular the vets at White Hart Lane have taken a lot of care over investigating and continuing to treat our elderly cat for on going age related conditions.  Thank you to all staff concerned, your expertise and kindness is very much appreciated.
Always friendly and caring towards my pet
The vet was kind and knowledgable. I felt part of the consultation, and our cat was happy, too.
Mediate Barnes White Hart Lane is very accommodating and has found a slot for my dog who is 13 years old and needs to be cared. Its staff are very professional and excellent.
Quick Friendly service . Kept me and my dog , Daisy , calm . Appointment was thorough with options for treatment and care . Nadine is fantastic and dealt with insurance claim quickly
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
